subject: Satellite vendor quick onboard / limited no-PO path request
messages:
From: Leah Morgan <leah@starlightsystems.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-31T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick onboarding ask — 30d trial (no-PO?)

Hi Camila,

We're excited to kick off a short technical pilot with Redwood — thanks for the quick responses so far.

Can Starlight do a 30-day trial where we invoice at the end of the month without a formal PO? Our legal is fine with a short SOW; procurement at our side requires W-9 and an invoice template. Expected spend <= $2,500 for the trial.

I attached the W-9 and our invoice template. If a no-PO path isn't permitted, can you advise the fastest way to get an exception approved? We need to start next week if possible.

Thanks — Leah

Attachment stubs: starlight_w9.pdf (application/pdf); invoice-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-31T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick onboarding ask — 30d trial (no-PO?)

Team — forwarding a pilot request from Starlight Systems. Key points:
- Trial estimated <= $2.5k for 30 days
- Vendor provided W-9 + invoice template (attached)
- They ask for invoice-only / no-PO path to start next week

Options I'm considering:
1) Allow invoice-only for first 30 days under a \"satellite vendor\" limited approval (cap $3k), require SOW + card on file as fallback
2) Require PO but expedite via procurement priority (slow; client may drop)

Marissa — want to avoid blocking sales. David/Sean — can we get a short-form approval for vendors under $3k with controls listed below? If yes I will confirm to Leah and request signed SOW.

Proposed controls: SOW signed, monthly reconciliation, payment by invoice net 15, vendor on temporary allowlist for 90 days, finance review after first invoice.

Thanks — Camila

Camila Reyes

Camila — we can approve a conditional invoice-only onboarding for this specific pilot under the below constraints.

Conditions for one-time 90-day invoice-only path (Finance):
- Trial spend must be <= $3,000 total.
- Vendor must sign a short SOW (scope + deliverables + dates).
- W-9 required (received).
- Payment terms: Net 15; finance to set invoice routing code and reconciliation label \"SAT-PILOT\".
- Card-on-file recommended where possible; if not, require an internal PO-exception ticket (I will create).
- All invoices for the period go to finance@redwood.com and procurement@redwood.com.

I will create the PO-exception ticket and tag Sean for final sign-off. Also please capture a primary contact and billing address on the SOW.

David Kim
Sr. Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick onboarding ask — 30d trial (no-PO?)

Ack — I'm ok with a temporary exception for Starlight Systems with the Finance constraints David listed. One additional requirement from procurement: evidence of identity (company registration or primary contact LinkedIn) and a secondary approver from Sales (Marissa) to confirm business need.

Checklist for go-ahead (must be completed before first invoice):
- [x] W-9 (received)
- [ ] Signed short SOW (scope + dates + invoice address)
- [ ] Billing address & remit details captured in vendor profile
- [ ] Sales approval noted (Marissa)
- [ ] PO-exception ticket created and linked to deal HS-9821

Camila — once the items above are done, confirm here and I'll mark procurement approval and set allowlist flag for 90 days.

Regards,

1) Review and sign the short SOW I'm attaching to this thread (SOW stub attached).
2) Confirm billing address and remit details exactly as they should appear on invoice.
3) Point person for billing (name + phone)
